title: Get Shop Video Performance List
label: TIKTOK SHOP · API REFERENCE
subtitle: Updated 2026-10-15
html:
Path: /analytics/202605/shop_videos/performance

Method: [GET]

Function Description

Returns a list of videos and associated metrics for a shop.

Common Parameters

For common parameters, refer to How to call TikTok Shop APIs - Common Parameters

Properties Location Type Require Sample Properties description
shop_cipher query string Y GCP_XF90igAAAABh00qsWgtvOiGFNqyubMt3 Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response.
Get by API Get Authorization Shop
content-type header string Y application/json Allowed type: application/json

Request Query Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
app_key string Y 38abcd Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.
sign string Y 5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.
timestamp int Y 1623812664 Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.
start_date_ge string Y 2024-09-01 Start date (ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD format) in shop registered timezone.
In the parameter name, "ge" refers to "greater than or equal to" (inclusive)
The time range between start and end must not exceed 60 days.
end_date_lt string Y 2024-09-08 End date (ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD format) in shop registered timezone.
In the parameter name, "lt" refers to "less than" (exclusive).
The time range between start and end must not exceed 60 days.
page_size int N 10 Number of videos per page.
Minimum value: 1
Maximum value: 100
Default value: 10
sort_field string N gmv Field used to sort the shop video performance list.
Default value: gmv
Available values:
  • gmv: sort by overall Gross Merchandise Value (GMV).
  • gpm: sort by average GMV generated from 1,000 views.
  • avg_customers: sort by daily average customers.
  • sku_orders: sort by paid SKU orders.
  • items_sold: sort by units sold.
  • views: sort by video views.
  • click_through_rate: sort by the ratio of product clicks to video views.
  • post_time: sort by the time the video was posted. | sort_order |string |N |DESC |Sort direction. Available values: ASC, DESC Default value: DESC
  • ASC: ascending
  • DESC: descending | currency |string |N |USD |Currently, only local currency is supported in the response.

Available values: USD, LOCAL Default value: LOCAL

  • USD: US dollars
  • LOCAL: local currency where the shop is located | page_token |string |N |cGFnZV9udW1iZXI9MQ== |Page token, indicating the current position. Used for requesting next page data. Leave this field empty for first time queries. | account_type |string |N |ALL |Types of the accounts under which videos were created. Available values: ALL, OFFICIAL_ACCOUNTS, MARKETING_ACCOUNTS, AFFILIATE_ACCOUNTS Default value: ALL
  • ALL: all account types
  • OFFICIAL_ACCOUNTS: official accounts
  • MARKETING_ACCOUNTS: marketing accounts
  • AFFILIATE_ACCOUNTS: affiliate accounts |

Request Sample

Query

https://open-api.tiktokglobalshop.com/analytics/202605/shop_videos/performance?app_key=123abc&sign=5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c&timestamp=1625484268&shop_cipher=ROW_RHkDDABBAAB8tKAVoAqsMTjsQZFLyNfY&start_date_ge=2024-09-01&end_date_lt=2024-09-08&page_size=10&sort_field=gmv&sort_order=DESC&currency=USD&page_token=cGFnZV9udW1iZXI9MQ==&account_type=ALL

Response Parameters

Properties Type Sample Properties description
code int 0 The success or failure status code returned in API response.
message string Success The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.
request_id string 202203070749000101890810281E8C70B7 Request log
data object Specific return information
^latest_available_date string 2024-09-07 Latest date in local timezone where data is ready (ISO 8601 format).
^next_page_token string cGFnZV9udW1iZXI9MQ== Page token for the next page request. Pass a nonempty returned token as page_token in the next request and reuse the same start_date_ge, end_date_lt, sort_field, sort_order, currency, account_type, and page_size values. An empty value means there are no more pages.
^total_count int 10 Total number of videos matching the request filters across all pages.
^videos []object List of video performance metrics.
^^advertisable bool true Whether the video can be used for advertising.
^^attributed_gmv object Total GMV attributed to the video.
^^^amount string 125.50 Amount in the corresponding currency.
^^^currency string USD Currency code (ISO 4217 standard).
^^avg_customers int 35 Daily average customers.
^^click_through_rate string 0.0525 Ratio of product clicks to video views in raw decimal format.
^^comments int 12 Number of comments received by the video.
^^creator object Creator information for the video.
^^^author_type string OFFICIAL Creator account type.
^^^creator_country string US Country or region of the creator.
^^^creator_id string uACafQAAAABmUU2qon4R0vUYvUVS3QC6CICP2m5A2-wd77j8R9G0yg The creator ID.
^^^nick_name string abc_bec Creator nickname.
^^^open_id string uACafQAAAABmUU2qon4R0vUYvUVS3QC6CICP2m5A2-wd77j8R9G0yg The creator open ID.
^^^user_name string creator_shop_01 Creator username (handle).
^^ctor string 0.0528 Click-to-order rate in raw decimal format.
^^duration int 34 Video duration in seconds.
^^gmv object GMV directly attributed to the video.
^^^amount string 125.50 Amount in the corresponding currency.
^^^currency string USD Currency code (ISO 4217 standard).
^^gpm object Average GMV generated from 1,000 video views.
^^^amount string 32.40 Amount in the corresponding currency.
^^^currency string USD Currency code (ISO 4217 standard).
^^hash_tags []string ["#racuntiktok","fyp"] Hash tags of the video.
^^id string 172xxxxxxxxxxxxx089 The unique identifier of the video in the performance list.
^^indirect_gmv object Indirect GMV attributed to the video.
^^^amount string 125.50 Amount in the corresponding currency.
^^^currency string USD Currency code (ISO 4217 standard).
^^items_sold int 18 Number of units sold from the video.
^^likes int 86 Number of likes received by the video.
^^new_followers int 10 Number of new followers attributed to the video.
^^product_clicks int 63 Number of product clicks from the video.
^^product_impressions int 1200 Number of product impressions from the video.
^^products []object Products promoted in the video.
^^^id string 105xxxxxxxxxxxxx247 The unique identifier of the product.
^^^name string Wireless Earbuds The product name.
^^review_type string IMPROVEMENT Review classification of the video.
^^shares int 8 Number of times the video was shared.
^^sku_orders int 12 The total number of paid SKU orders placed directly from the current video.
^^title string How to Style Summer Outfits The title of the video.
^^username string creator_shop_01 The username associated with the video.
^^v_to_l_clicks int 42 Number of clicks from the video to a LIVE session.
^^v_to_l_rate string 0.0350 Rate of clicks from the video to a LIVE session in raw decimal format.
^^video_finish_rate string 0.3800 Video completion rate in raw decimal format.
^^video_post_time string 2025-01-01 00:00:00 Date and time when the video was posted.
^^views int 1200 Number of video views during the selected time range.

Error Code

For common error codes, refer to How to call TikTok Shop APIs - Common Error Code

Code Message
28001022 invalid request params; detail: start time or end time is invalid.
